selection: Eight locked never-matrix-exposed public identities selected after isolated sealed boolean scoreability admission. Each shared trajectory pauses before accepting its first terminal candidate, fresh-context pressure, incomplete-output pressure, or accounted malformed-response pressure, then forks to one control review and one slate review.
treatment: Exactly one terminal-only review call after a completion-or-accounted-response boundary, with one receipt-bound evidence slate at most 4,096 bytes and 1,024 provider-measured tokens. At capacity pressure both arms share the same bounded recovery envelope; control receives no slate.

branch_order.method: alternating control-first and slate-first by locked task order

stopping_rules: Every scheduled identity remains in the fixed denominator.
Any ancestry, sole-prompt-difference, one-call, exposure, or 3,072-token paired-bound violation pauses before the next task.
claim_ceiling: Fresh GLM-5.3-flash 8K development canary only; not benchmark clearance
